=== Section 1: Resistance selection and current ===
Supply voltage: 9.00 V. LED forward drop (exact): 2.40 V. Resistor voltage drop: 9.00 V - 2.40 V = 6.60 V.
Selected resistor: 330 Ω.
Current: I = 6.60 V / 330 Ω = 0.0200 A = 20.0 mA.
Check against constraint: 18.0 mA ≤ 20.0 mA ≤ 22.0 mA → PASS (inclusive bounds satisfied).

=== Section 2: Checks of the other resistance choices ===
Option 270 Ω: I = 6.60 V / 270 Ω = 0.02444... A ≈ 24.4 mA. 24.4 mA > 22.0 mA → FAIL (exceeds upper bound).
Option 390 Ω: I = 6.60 V / 390 Ω = 0.01692... A ≈ 16.9 mA. 16.9 mA < 18.0 mA → FAIL (below lower bound).
Only 330 Ω yields current within the required [18.0, 22.0] mA window.

=== Section 3: Dissipation and power-rating selection ===
Actual resistor dissipation: P = V_R × I = 6.60 V × 0.0200 A = 0.132 W (confirmed by P = I²R = (0.0200 A)² × 330 Ω = 0.132 W).
Derating requirement: rating ≥ 2 × P = 2 × 0.132 W = 0.264 W (equality allowed).
Available ratings evaluated:
- 0.125 W: 0.125 W < 0.264 W → FAIL
- 0.250 W: 0.250 W < 0.264 W → FAIL (does not meet ≥ 0.264 W)
- 0.500 W: 0.500 W ≥ 0.264 W → PASS
Smallest passing rating: 0.500 W (1/2 W).

Final specification: 330 Ω series resistor, 0.500 W power rating.

- k_s = (200e9 Pa)(100e-6 m²)/1.00 m = 2.00e7 N/m = 20.0 MN/m

Compatibility (equal extension δ): F_a/k_a = F_s/k_s => F_a = (k_a/k_s)F_s = 0.70 F_s.
Equilibrium: F_a + F_s = 30,000 N => 1.70 F_s = 30,000 N.

Verification: F_a + F_s = 30.0 kN; δ computed from both bars matches; stresses are within typical proportional limits, confirming linear-elastic behavior with no thermal effect. WORK INSTRUCTION — ADHESIVE COUPON CURE-CHECK SEQUENCE (Guarded Laboratory Oven)

1. SETUP / PRE-CONDITION
   - Confirm coupon and temperature probe are installed and secured.
   - Confirm oven is guarded and chamber is closed.

2. PROCEDURE STEPS
   Step 1 — Set oven: Set the oven controller to 120°C.
   Step 2 — Wait for entry band: Monitor the coupon probe. Do not start timing until the coupon temperature enters the inclusive band 118°C to 122°C.
   Step 3 — Start timer: Once the coupon temperature is within 118–122°C, start the 600 s timer immediately.
   Step 4 — Hold constraint (continuous): The coupon must remain inside the inclusive band 118°C to 122°C for the entire 600 s timed hold.
   Step 5 — Excursion / failure rule: Any excursion outside 118–122°C at any time during the 600 s hold fails the run.
   Step 6 — No restart: If the run fails, no restart is permitted for this coupon/run.
   Step 7 — Assess the run: At the end of the 600 s hold, record the outcome (PASS or FAIL) based on whether the coupon remained continuously within 118–122°C for the full duration.
   Step 8 — Switch off heating: After assessment, switch off the oven heating elements.
   Step 9 — Cooldown and removal: Leave the coupon inside the oven (heating off) until its probe reads ≤40°C. Only then remove the coupon.

3. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (Step 10)
   - Oven setpoint: 120°C.
   - Hold initiation: Coupon temperature within inclusive band 118°C ≤ T ≤ 122°C.
   - Hold duration: Exactly 600 s.
   - Band maintenance: Coupon temperature must remain within 118°C ≤ T ≤ 122°C for the full 600 s without interruption.
   - Excursion: Any value T < 118°C or T > 122°C during the hold = FAIL.
   - Restart policy: None permitted after failure.
   - Post-hold: Heating disabled; coupon remains in chamber until probe reads ≤40°C before removal.

4. LOG VERDICT (Step 11)
   Log data: Uninterrupted 600 s hold; recorded minimum 119°C; recorded maximum 121°C.
   Assessment: 119°C ≥ 118°C and 121°C ≤ 122°C; the full interval [119°C, 121°C] lies entirely within the required [118°C, 122°C] band. Duration equals 600 s with no reported excursion.
   Verdict: PASS.

5. ASSUMPTIONS / UNVERIFIED PARAMETERS (not fabricated as specifications)
   - Data logging frequency and resolution: Not specified in source material; assumed sufficient to detect excursions.
   - Maximum allowable ramp-up duration to reach 118°C: Unverified; no universal upper limit established in available sources (DIN 12880:2007, ASTM E145-94, manufacturer examples only).
   - Cooldown protocol (sealed vs. vented): Not specified; procedure assumes chamber remains closed with heating off until ≤40°C.
   - Probe calibration, measurement uncertainty, and physical bonding: Not quantified here.
   - Document numbering, sign-off, and post-test quarantine/tagging: Not specified in the request and omitted.

6. SAFETY / KILL TRIGGERS (operational, not requested as formal falsifiers)
   - Abort trigger: Probe reads <118°C or >122°C during the 600 s hold → immediate FAIL; do not restart.
   - Removal trigger: Probe must read ≤40°C; do not open/remove earlier.
   - Thermal hazard: Oven and coupon may be hot; use appropriate PPE during verification and removal at ≤40°C.
